overview: The Hall of Distorted Reality is where Grieg’s madness becomes visible.
details: Mirrors reflect impossible angles. Illusions manifest as hostile echoes. Psychic distortions twist corridors into inverted shapes. The Mirror-Sovereign rules this hall, enforcing Grieg’s warped vision.
hooks: A reflection steps out of a mirror and attacks.
An illusion of Grieg appears and speaks nonsense.
Mirrors crack as psychic pressure builds.
